Frequently Asked Questions

Where was Jason Collins born?

Jason Collins was born in Northridge, California.

Jason Collins was born on December 2, 1978.

How tall was Jason Collins?

Jason Collins was 7-0 (213 cm) tall.

How much did Jason Collins weigh when playing?

Jason Collins weighed 255 lbs (115 kg) when playing.

Is Jason Collins in the Hall of Fame?

Jason Collins is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Jason Collins drafted?

Jason Collins was drafted by Houston Rockets, 1st round (18th pick, 18th overall), 2001 NBA Draft.

Center and Power Forward.

When did Jason Collins retire?

Jason Collins last played in 2014.

What did Jason Collins average?

Jason Collins averaged 3.6 points, 3.7 rebounds, and 0.9 assists per game.

How many rings does Jason Collins have?

Jason Collins won 0 championships.

What schools did Jason Collins attend?

Jason Collins attended Harvard-Westlake School in Los Angeles, California and Stanford.
